purpose: Build a minimal, A-private, deduplicated recovery plan for missing formal BLIND runtime attempts before any separate execution gate.

inputs.source: in-memory immutable log and measurement snapshots accepted by blind-runtime-join-v12-r5
inputs.single_full_source_rule: 01_single_mode_full is allowed only for exact run ids s9234_H_full_phase3_v2 and wb_dma_H_full_phase4_v2 when reused by formal HF/HMF measurement tables; it is one deduplicated H full attempt per circuit.

classification.plan: exactly zero matching logs for a formal H or M measurement reference with a legal, stage-consistent run_id; M records bind an H dependency derived from the same measurement row and declare full or limited execution
classification.out_of_scope: a missing formal F reference is refused rather than planned
classification.skip: exactly one matching log with nonempty measured wall time
refuse: existing log without measured wall time

isolation.historical_directories: read-only; never write, rename, remove, or reuse historical output roots
isolation.execution: this contract and its plan builder do not contain a Tessent command or submit an LSF job
isolation.merge: any recovered evidence requires a later immutable source manifest and an independent candidate-to-runtime join audit

gates.lsf_submission: requires a separately reviewed recovery-runner contract, exact command binding, private-plan digest, and explicit execution authorization
gates.training: false until recovery, R06/R07/R13, and independent audit all pass

implementation.seal_rule: A primary-agent reviewed final seal must replace every PENDING_ROOT_SEAL value with a SHA-256 before deployment beyond local tests.
